quit.title: QUIT
quit.note_match: Quit Recharged? The game closes, and the match is not finished.

gameplay.title: GAMEPLAY
gameplay.in_match: A match is on: it keeps the options it started with.

menus.name: Menus
menus.about: How the menus run; a change takes effect at once. Skip intro is in the launcher: it needs the game started again.

matches.name: Matches
matches.about: Who plays and how the teams look; changes take effect from the next match. Robot goalies, Super Team and Unlock everything are in the launcher: they need the game started again.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.about: Rules for fairer matches; changes take effect from the next match.

display.camera_online: The match camera can be changed outside online matches.
display.camera_about: DYNAMIC zooms in and out with the play; STATIC keeps the zoom level below. Saved with the game, as in its Visual Options.
display.zoom_level_about: How far the camera stays from the play (1 nearest), when it does not zoom by itself.
display.picture_about: {{shape}} keeps the game's shape, Stretch fills the window.
display.picture_about_wider: {{shape}} keeps the game's shape, Stretch fills the window, Wider view shows more of the stadium in matches.
display.resolution_about: How sharp the game draws its 3D: Full at the window's size ({{full}}), Native at the Wii's {{native}}, 2x to 4x at its multiples, for slower graphics cards.
display.performance_numbers_about: The frame rate and how busy the graphics card and processor are, in a corner of the picture.

advanced.reopen_launcher_about: The launcher opens again when the game closes.
advanced.no_launcher: The game started without the launcher: closing it opens nothing.
advanced.launcher_size_about: Scales the launcher. Automatic follows your display's scaling setting.
advanced.graphics_api_about: Automatic uses Vulkan, or DirectX 12 when Vulkan cannot start. Used the next time you start the game.
advanced.graphics_api_only: The one this computer's game uses.
advanced.graphics_card_about: Automatic uses the fastest. Used the next time you start the game.
advanced.looking_about: Looking for the computer's graphics cards.
advanced.performance_stats_about: Records frame times for each game session, with the arena and settings, in the logs folder. From the next start.
advanced.api_validation_about: Checks every graphics call for errors. Useful for bug reports, but slower. From the next start.
advanced.log_detail_about: Which messages reach the console and the log. From the next start.
advanced.verbose_console_about: Also prints development traces and the game's own debug output.
advanced.log_window_about: Shows the log in a separate window. Closing it doesn't stop the game.
advanced.launcher_note: The settings file, the folders and resetting everything are in the launcher's Advanced page.

sound.game_levels_about: The game's own volume bars, saved with the game as in its Audio Options; Recharged's levels above work on top of them.
sound.challenge_sound_about: A chime when someone challenges you or accepts your challenge.

players.title: PLAYERS
players.no_profile: Online needs a player profile: the launcher's Player profile page makes one.
players.in_match: You're in a match: challenges wait until it ends.
players.no_rules: This server has no rules to play sets by yet.
players.no_friends_online: None of your friends is online
players.nobody_open: Nobody else is open to challenges right now

you.no_profile: Make one on the launcher's Player profile page: then friends, challenges, sets and the leaderboards are here.
you.open_switch_about: Others see you as available and can challenge you, also to random games.
you.find_opponent_about: A random opponent, by the rules you choose.

player.title: PLAYER
player.challenge_about: A set by the rules you choose.

setup.changed: Changed for this one only: the preset stays as it is.

ranked.title: RANKED
ranked.about: Play anybody online, as from the game's online menu.
ranked.about_leaderboards: Your wins and losses go on the leaderboards.
ranked.waiting: On the way to RANKED: go back to the main menu or the online menu, the game goes on from there.
ranked.choose_mii: You choose your Mii in the game.
ranked.blocked_game: This game can't go to RANKED by itself.
ranked.blocked_match: You're in a match: RANKED waits until it is over.
ranked.blocked_set: Your set goes on: RANKED waits until it is over.
ranked.blocked_search: You're searching for an opponent: stop that first.

leaderboard.title: LEADERBOARD
leaderboard.no_profile: The leaderboards need a player profile: the launcher's Player profile page makes one.
leaderboard.missing: This server has no leaderboards yet.
leaderboard.nobody_today: Nobody has played RANKED today yet.

forfeit.title: FORFEIT
forfeit.match_note: The match ends for both of you and counts as a loss for you.
forfeit.set_note: The set ends for both of you: you lose it, whatever the score.

prompt.title: CHALLENGE
prompt.note: Accept, and your game goes straight to the set.
prompt.random_note: They searched for an opponent by these rules. Accept, and your game goes straight to the set.

set_end.rematch_asks_note: A rematch asks {{name}} to play the same set again.
set_end.play_again_note: Play it again is your Ready to play!: the set goes once {{name}} is ready too.
set_end.forfeited_reason: It counts as a loss for you.
set_end.opponent_forfeited_reason: {{name}} left the match and gave the set up.
set_end.gone_crying: {{name}} ran crying to the dressing room…
set_end.gone_home: {{name}} took the ball and went home…
set_end.gone_lineup: {{name}} saw your lineup and fled the pitch…
set_end.gone_kritters: {{name}} heard the Kritters were coming and ran…
set_end.opponent_closed_reason: {{name}}'s game closed before your games met, so the set stopped.
set_end.opponent_left_reason: {{name}} left before your games met, so the set stopped.
set_end.failed_reason: A message in the game ended it.
set_end.you_left_reason: You left the search; {{name}}'s game was told.
set_end.not_ready_reason: {{name}} isn't ready any more, or your games didn't meet in time.
set_end.rematch_note: The same set again: {{name}} gets the challenge.
set_end.play_again_call_off_note: Play it again is your Ready to play!: the set goes once {{name}} is ready too. Not now calls it off.

sets.starting: Both are ready: the set starts
sets.play_ranked: Play RANKED in the game's online menu
sets.results_differ_about: The two games saw different results; nothing was counted.

blocked.mii: Play them in the game's online menu

messages.opponent_forfeited: {{name}} forfeited the match: the win is yours
messages.set_waits: The set waits: go back to the main menu or the online menu, and the game takes you to RANKED
messages.set_replaced: Your other Recharged plays the set against {{name}}
messages.set_no_result: The set against {{name}} ended without a result
messages.server_no_answer: The server didn't answer. Try again on the launcher's Online pages.
messages.challenge_gone: The challenge is no longer open.
messages.rematch_gone: No rematch: the set is no longer there.
messages.set_gone: The set is no longer open.
messages.ranked_waits: RANKED waits: go back to the main menu or the online menu, and the game takes you there
messages.mii_unknown: this Mii plays for no Recharged profile
messages.wider_view: Wider view: more of the stadium in matches
messages.stretched: Picture stretched to fill the window

notices.rules_not_saved: Your challenges' rules were not saved: {{error}}
